title: 第11章 献祭第12章 松果异变
lines: 一只蝎子从黄钟信的眼窝中钻出，顺着眼球背后一戳——啪！
左眼炸裂，眼珠落地，在石板上溅起一滩混着血的稀液。
“不错……再来点。”
麻衣老者像砍木头一般，继续挥刀割肉，将其投进玉瓶中，那些蝎子闻着鲜肉的气息，更加疯狂。
黄钟信的身子抖得像筛糠一般，生命正从他眼中一点一点褪去。
最后，麻衣老者低声念诵一段古老咒文，刀尖一震，一道漆黑如墨的光芒从刀上跃出，精准无误地钻入黄钟信眉心。
那一刻，黄钟信的头骨黑气翻滚，体内最后一口气也随之溃散。
“怨魂成。”
麻衣老者收刀归鞘，满意地点点头。
阴风如鬼哭，吹得那山谷四壁回音阵阵，仿佛从地底传来亡灵的低语。
麻衣老者低头望着地上一众孩童，脸上浮现出一种近乎病态的笑意，那笑意像瘟疫一般传染开来，让人从骨子里寒冷。
他缓缓踱步，步履不紧不慢，像是在挑选猎物。
他喉中发出怪笑，眼睛最终落在了一个瘦小的身子上，那人缩成一团，脸上写满了惊恐。
老者伸手拎起他，像提一块腐肉般，将他猛然甩向了身后魔幡的位置！
那小小的身子重重地落在幡前的血阵中，尘土飞扬，骨头似乎都要被震裂。
他喉中发出呜咽，眼神已经彻底崩溃。
麻衣老者却没有任何怜悯之意，他站在魔幡前，嘴唇微动，咒语仿佛从九幽之下传来，古老而沉重。
随着咒音回荡，四周地面浮现出的红色符文像是活了过来，血光游走，盘旋而起。
他右手猛然一划——“呲啦！”
鲜血从掌心喷涌，滴落在地。
他没有停下，神色更加凝重，一步步走向魔幡。
那魔幡，如一道直插天穹的黑柱，幡面无风自动，黑得发亮，仿佛吞噬了所有光线。
四周的天地都因它而失去了颜色。
麻衣老者站在幡前，将手掌的鲜血猛然洒在幡上。
“滋滋滋——”
鲜血沾上幡布，没有落下，反而被诡异地吸收。
幡面像一块皮肤，血液融入其内，表面蠕动起来，一道道细纹浮现，仿若血管。
content_en:
A scorpion emerged from Huang Zhongxin's eye socket and poked behind the eyeball - snap!
The left eye exploded and fell to the ground, splashing a pool of thin liquid mixed with blood on the stone floor.
"Not bad... More."
The old man in sackcloth continued to cut the meat with his knife as if chopping wood, and threw it into the jade bottle. The scorpions smelled the smell of fresh meat and became even more crazy.
"Woooo..."
Huang Zhongxin's body was shaking like chaff, and the life was fading away from his eyes bit by bit.
Finally, the old man in sackcloth recited an ancient mantra in a low voice. The tip of the knife shook, and a jet-black light as black as ink jumped out from the knife and penetrated into the center of Huang Zhongxin's eyebrows accurately.
At that moment, Huang Zhongxin's skull rolled with black energy, and the last breath of his body disappeared.
"The resentful soul is established."
The old man in sackcloth sheathed his sword and nodded with satisfaction.
The dark wind was like a ghost crying, making waves echo from the walls of the valley, as if the whispers of the dead were coming from the ground.
The old man in sackcloth looked down at the children on the ground, with an almost sick smile on his face. That smile spread like a plague, chilling people to the core.
He walked slowly, unhurriedly, as if he was selecting prey.
"Giggle..."
A weird laugh broke out from his throat, and his eyes finally fell on a thin body. The man huddled up, with fear written on his face.
"Come on..."
The old man reached out and picked him up, like a piece of rotten meat, and threw him to the position of the magic flag behind him!
"Boom——!"
The small body fell heavily into the blood array in front of the flag, dust flew up, and the bones seemed to be shattered.
There was a sob in his throat, and his eyes were completely broken.
The old man in sackcloth didn't have any mercy. He stood in front of the magic flag, his lips moved slightly, and the spell seemed to be coming from under the Nine Netherworld, ancient and heavy.
As the sound of the curse reverberated, the red runes emerging from the surrounding ground seemed to come to life, and the blood light swam and hovered.
He made a sudden stroke with his right hand - "Hey!"
Blood spurted from his palms and dripped to the ground.
He didn't stop, his expression became more solemn, and he walked towards the magic banner step by step.
The magic flag was like a black pillar that shot straight into the sky. The flag's surface moved without any wind, and was so black that it seemed to swallow up all the light.
The surrounding heaven and earth have lost their color because of it.
The old man in sackcloth stood in front of the flag and suddenly sprinkled the blood from his palm on the flag.
"Zizzizi——"
The blood stained the banner cloth, but did not fall, but was absorbed strangely.
The banner surface is like a piece of skin, with blood melting into it, the surface squirms, and fine lines appear like blood vessels.
